hearth.waiting_host: Waiting for the host to open the world…
hearth.host_not_ready: The host has not provided a connection address yet. Try again shortly.
hearth.steam_required: Install e4steam and sign in to Steam to host or join shared worlds.
hearth.steam_open_failed: Hearth could not open the world for friends. Leave the world to release the host session.
hearth.steam_timeout: Steam did not provide a join address. Check e4steam and your Steam sign-in; friends cannot join yet.
hearth.take_over_warning: %s stopped responding. Continue from the last save? Their progress after it will be kept as a separate version.
hearth.empty: No shared worlds yet. Paste an invite from a friend or share one of your worlds.
hearth.you_unsaved: your last session wasn't saved, host to continue
hearth.share_own: Or share a world from this computer
hearth.repo_help: GitHub: create an empty private repo, then Settings → Developer settings → Fine-grained token with Contents: Read and write for that repo.
hearth.lost_lock: Someone took over this world while you were away. Your progress was kept as version %s.
hearth.wrong_version: This world is played on Minecraft %s, you run %s.
hearth.open_from_hearth: This is a shared world. Open it from Singleplayer → Shared worlds so others know you're playing.
hearth.github_creator_help: Only the creator signs in. Hearth creates a private repository and separate access keys for friends. GitHub asks for private repository access; this login stays on your computer.
hearth.invite_private: Invite copied. Send it privately to one friend: it gives access to this world. Each invite can be revoked separately.
hearth.revoke_warning: Revoke access for %s? Their invite will stop downloading and hosting this world.
hearth.profile_rejected: This Hearth profile is not invited, is banned, or could not prove its identity.
hearth.commands_disabled: The creator disabled commands for participants.
hearth.approve_mods_warning: Use the mods currently installed on your computer as the world’s approved mod set? Members will need the same shared mods and versions.
hearth.restore_warning: Restore the save from %s? Stop the current session first. This adds a new save to history; current bans and creator rules stay in effect.
hearth.unban_warning: Restore access for %s? Their existing invite will work again.
hearth.members_empty: Invite a friend to see them here.
hearth.invalid_ip: Enter a valid IPv4 or IPv6 address.
hearth.ip_help: IP bans apply to direct connections. Steam hides addresses: use a profile ban for Steam players.
hearth.transport_help: Local network connects computers on the same network. Sign in to the desktop Steam client to connect over the internet.
hearth.steam_lan_fallback: Steam is unavailable. This session uses the local network.
hearth.finish_current_session: Leave the current world before starting another.
